en.bdb: Having the sight of the true Guru, the Sikh of the Guru concentrates upon Him.
Pondering upon the word of true Guru he cultivates knowledge.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਕਵਲ ਗੁਰ ਮੰਤੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: charan kaval gur ma(n)t chit vasaiaa|

en.bdb: He keeps to his heart the mantra and the lotus feet of Guru.
He serves the true Guru and consequently makes the whole world serve him.
The Guru loves disciple and disciple makes the whole world happy.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੰਥੁ ਚਲਾਇ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਛਾਇਆ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit_en: gurmukh pa(n)th chalai nij ghar chhaiaa ||14||

en.bdb: This way, that disciple creates a religion of the Gurmukhs and situates in his own self.
